tables.title: Engineer rules
rows: Every other resource consumes Idea. Keep it your most-crafted resource or you hit constant bottlenecks.

With no upgrades Idea makes 720 an hour, while Blueprint and Runic Blueprint together use 1,067. Sun Scroll uses 25.5 Blueprint and 18.2 Runic Blueprint an hour against 20 and 6.7 made. So nothing above Idea runs nonstop until the slots below it are sped up.

For Sun Scroll to run nonstop, the slots below must be faster than it by about these factors: Runic Blueprint 2.7 times, Blueprint 2.2 times, Idea 3.6 times. The wiki's efficiency calculator works this out for your own numbers.

Each slot has four speed upgrades. Gold Upgrade gives +20% a level and doubles in price each level (from 1,000 gold for Idea, 30,000 for Blueprint, 100,000 for Runic Blueprint, 300,000 for Sun Scroll). The item, wood and ore upgrades give +5% a level and rotate through materials of that slot's act.

Idea and Blueprint use Act 1 materials (Blueprint wants Pyrewood Log and Iron Ore), Runic Blueprint uses Act 2 monster drops, Ironwood Log and Thorium Ore, and Sun Scroll uses Act 3 drops, Palm Tree Log and Sunstone Ore.
Each Engineer Slot Upgrade doubles one resource's generation: Idea, then Blueprint, Runic Blueprint, Sun Scroll (150, 250, 350, 500 gems).
A red, negative rate means a resource is consumed faster than it is made. Pause the consumer: select it and press the pause button beside the main image.

Each level adds a 5% chance that a Hunter level refunds half its materials. Ten levels (Idea and Blueprint) make it a 50% chance, about a quarter off Hunter costs on average. Humble Sacrifices does the same for sacrifices, up to 25%.

Adds combat multiloot, which raises the ordinary drop every monster gives, including Hunter and sacrifice materials. It is in three tiers (10 levels each), so it is the Engineer's main help for material farming.
The Idea and Blueprint versions raise the Act 1 vendor's daily stock; the Runic Blueprint one raises the Act 2 vendor's (more Crystallized Yellow Substance a day); the Sun Scroll one raises Act 3's.
Each Daily Activity Enhancer adds 1 key for finishing the daily quests, and each keyring level raises the key cap by 1 (5 levels in each of three tiers).
Remote Engineering (6,000 Blueprint) lets slot upgrades take materials from the stash; Remote Crafting, Remote Hunting and Remote Sacrificing do the same for those systems.

Smelting Patterns (+6% smeltery speed a level) and Combat Experience (+1%) cost 276 Blueprint for 20 levels, 748 for 30 and 4,472 for 50. Bonfire Prototyping (+1% ash chance) and Pet Training (+2% pet XP) cost 215 Runic Blueprint for 20, 558 for 30 and 2,871 for 50. All go to 200.
Crit chance above 100% becomes a chance of a double crit (130% is a 30% chance). There are no triple crits, so nothing past 200% helps.
Unlock everything, but do not neglect Hunter and sacrifices meanwhile.
